summary: Accepted (#4822, PR #4841, hosted run 39948229198, fdev acceptance 2026-10-23) for the unpinned public FS.GG.NewSddWorkspace 0.22.0 (signed archive caa91285, source 6e6fb9b9) with SDD.Cli 2.4.0, Workspace.Template 0.19.3 and UI.Template 0.32.3. When --lifecycle is omitted, fable-game takes the provider descriptor default, typed-sdd (#4811); the Wizard logs 'lifecycle selected from published provider'. Every other template, Rendering included, takes the Wizard's own sdd default, logged as 'lifecycle sdd'. The Rendering descriptor default is also sdd. Rendering Wizard default rows (app, game) therefore produce the sdd lane: no canonical store and no knowledge CI, with the capture guide still seeded. fable-game PLAYER (the default bundle) and COMPLETE, with explicit typed-sdd or omitted lifecycle, give identical typed workspaces. Each has exact local pins (Fable 5.18.0, Fantomas 8.0.5, Coord 0.94.0, SDD 2.4.0), the canonical store and guide, and owner CI byte-identical to the 0.19.3 fs-gg-fable-game payload. The Wizard makes no background commit; it only reports that initialization is required. These workspaces pass the normal initial commit, the #4723 knowledge probe, an ALL-shared export taken after private capture, and the 10,485,760-byte checker boundary, with product bytes preserved. Non-SVG (svgFoundation=false) is not a Wizard route: the Wizard has no svg option and no generic parameter passthrough, and --svg-foundation fails with exit 2 'unknown argument' before any target exists. fdev ratified that refusal control in place of non-SVG Wizard rows; non-SVG knowledge readiness is covered by the provider (#4773) and raw (#4769) routes. Pinned Wizard creations with product builds are separately qualified by the FS.GG.Templates fable-reference-public verifier (Templates#760, run 39946080162). Limits: unpinned, so it depends on Templates main descriptors (rendering ff49732a, fable-game 6b3d8f2d) and on 2.4.0 being the newest SDD; the self-update step ran as a no-op. Any later publish or descriptor change will fail the run closed. One Linux host.
title: Published Wizard 0.22.0 lifecycle defaults and knowledge rows
